summary: Takeda filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing that the U.S. FDA accepted its New Drug Application under Priority Review for zasocitinib (TAK-279), an investigational oral TYK2 inhibitor for adults with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis. The filing cites pivotal Phase 3 LATITUDE PsO 3001, 3002 and supportive 3003 data across nearly 3,000 patients, with roughly 70% achieving sPGA 0/1 at week 16. The PDUFA target action date falls in Q1 calendar 2027; the EMA also accepted a parallel marketing authorization application. Takeda states no significant impact on its FY ending March 2027 forecast. This is a product-regulatory milestone, not a special situation; watch pipeline/regulatory catalysts.
